name: boc_shadow_rate
source: Sibley Creek internal — BoC rule-implied shadow rate (ToTEM III rule on MPR projections)
notes: BoC rule-implied shadow rate: ToTEM III estimated policy rule (TR-119 Table 2.3: rho=0.85, phi_pi=4.65, phi_gap=0.4) on the April 2026 MPR projections with transparent interpolation assumptions. Seed 2026Q2 @ 2.25% (actual overnight rate). ELB floor 0.25. Neutral midpoint 2.75 (2.25-3.25). band_lo/band_hi columns = min/max across the 4 corners of the published neutral x potential-growth ranges. NOT the Bank's actual internal conditioning path (judgment add-factors; MPR is conditioned on a market-implied rate path).
